name: infogen-workbuddy
description: 加入了AI的SpaceEngine详细信息生成器，适配0.99x，可向下兼容0.980。 / New SpaceEngine Detailed Information Generator with AI

displayDescription.zh: 通过 MCP 读取 InfoGen 行星系统数据，生成忠于数据的系统详情与文明、矿产等扩展设定。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 为某个行星系统生成一份详细信息概览
defaultInitPrompt.en: Generate a detailed information overview for a planetary system

quickPrompts.en: Generate a detailed information overview for a planetary system
quickPrompts.zh: 为某个行星系统生成一份详细信息概览

quickPrompts.en: List all planets in a system and compare their physical parameters
quickPrompts.zh: 列出某系统内的全部行星并对比物理参数

quickPrompts.en: Design civilization and mineral settings for a planet based on its data
quickPrompts.zh: 基于某行星的数据设计文明与矿产设定
